[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/nO5dmWvA/spouse-reliefspouse-relief-disability#main-content) # Spouse Relief/Spouse Relief (Disability) - SupportGoWhere Spouse Relief/Spouse Relief (Disability) Share link Provides tax relief of up to $5,500 to both male and female taxpayers who have supported their spouses. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Spouse Relief of $2,000, up to $5,500 for spouse with disability or mental impairment [Apply now](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection) Expand all sections About this support - Spouse Relief of $2,000 for taxpayers who have supported their spouses - Spouse Relief (Disability) of $5,500 for taxpayers who have supported their spouses with disabilities Who is this for? **For Spouse Relief:** You must fulfil all these conditions in the previous year: - Your spouse has been living with / supported by you - Your spouse did not have an annual income of more than $8,000 - You have made maintenance payments under a Court Order or Deed of Separation (if you are legally separated from your spouse) **For Spouse Relief (Disability):** - Dependant must be certified by a doctor to require the need for assistance with any of the 6 Activities of Daily Living: - Washing or Bathing - Dressing - Feeding - Toileting - Transferring - Mobility - Dependant must be certified by a doctor to be impaired in any of these 3 areas: - Self-Care and Activities of Daily Living - Compliance to Psychiatric Treatment - Education or Work - No other claimants may claim the Parent Relief / Parent Relief (Disability) or Sibiling Relief (Disability) on the same dependant (your spouse) How to apply? **For e-Filing** Is this the first time you are claiming the relief? | Yes | No | | - Log in with Singpass or [Singpass Foreign user Account(SFA)](https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/others/singpass-foreign-user-account-(sfa)-for-foreign-individuals) at [myTax Portal](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection)

- Go to “Individuals” > “File Income Tax Return”

- Select “File” > File Income Tax Return

- Go to “4. Deductions, Tax Reliefs and Rebates”

- Select “Add New” > “Spouse”

- Fill in the relevant information and select “Update” | - If you were previously approved for relief last year, the amount will be pre-filled and granted to you automatically

- Follow the steps on the left and select “Not Claiming” if you wish to withdraw your claim | **For Paper Filing** Is this the first time you are claiming the relief? | Yes | No | | - Complete the item on “Spouse/Spouse Relief (Disability)” section on Form B1 & B

- Complete the particulars of your spouse in Appendix 2 | - Complete the item on “Spouse/Spouse Relief (Disability)” section on Form B1 & B | **For first-time Handicapped Spouse Relief claims:** Email 1 of the following documents via [myTax Mail](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection) - Completed Application for Claim of Disability Related Tax Reliefs - Letter / supporting documents from the disability association in respect of your spouse, indicating details of their disabilities Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/basics-of-individual-income-tax/tax-reliefs-rebates-and-deductions/tax-reliefs/spouse-relief-spouse-relief-(disability)) * * * IRAS hotline: [1800-356-8300](tel:1800-356-8300) Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. * * * [Submit an enquiry](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/individual-income-tax) * * * [Visit your nearest branch](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/locate-us) Scheme last updated 23 Sep 2025 Try our AI search
